headline: Executive order creates a new federal office to coordinate how government agencies enforce US trade rules and agreements.
what_it_does: This order sets up an Interagency Trade Enforcement Center. Based on its title, the center brings together staff from different federal agencies to work on enforcing trade rules. No summary was provided, so details about its exact powers, staffing, and budget are not covered here.

who_it_affects.how: They would coordinate their trade enforcement work through the new center.

who_it_affects.group: US businesses and workers in industries that export or compete with imports
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected by how actively the government pursues complaints about other countries' trade practices.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 28, 2012; executive orders like this generally take effect when signed.
